text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the West yard Door 2 double-booking at Marrow Fieldworks? Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. He called it his "dealer account" rather than naming Marrow Fieldworks. The Jan 2 Central handoff digest lists Marrow Fieldworks as the dealer account that changed hands on Jan 5, so it's very likely the same account, but I told Pree to confirm with Tobias. I also warned her not to confuse it with #4409 and #4412, which are older Fieldworks tickets about the Salina North yard.

I couldn't use gbrain because it refused the search: this connection isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. A brain-host admin can fix that with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`, or set it up to act on behalf of named members. I answered from the channels Pree belongs to and the public files instead.
